model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.raw_orde.name: raw_order_events
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.raw_orde.description: Append-only raw webhook ingestion stream from Shopify order events.
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.raw_orde.compiled_code:
-- Bronze Layer: Raw Shopify Webhook Events
SELECT
    order_id,
    event_date,
    category,
    gross_amount,
    ingested_at,
    source_system
FROM `showcase-retail-lakehouse.raw_shopify.orders_webhook`
WHERE ingested_at >= TIMESTAMP_SUB(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 30 DAY);

model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.fact_ord.name: fact_orders
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.fact_ord.description: Kimball Conformed Fact Table at Order grain (1 row per order_id) with deduplication and return flags.
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.fact_ord.compiled_code:
-- Silver Layer: Conformed Order Fact Table
WITH deduplicated AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CAST(event_date AS DATE) AS event_date,
        TRIM(category) AS category,
        TRIM(region) AS region,
        CAST(gross_amount AS NUMERIC) AS gross_amount,
        CAST(units AS INT64) AS units,
        CAST(is_returned AS INT64) AS is_returned,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY order_id ORDER BY ingested_at DESC) AS rn
    FROM `showcase-retail-lakehouse.main_bronze.raw_order_events`
)
SELECT
    order_id,
    event_date,
    category,
    region,
    gross_amount,
    units,
    is_returned
FROM deduplicated
WHERE rn = 1;

model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.mart_pro.name: mart_product_performance
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.mart_pro.description: Category-level aggregated performance mart computing GMV, Order Count, AOV, and Return Rate (%).
model.showcase_retail_lakehouse.mart_pro.compiled_code:
-- Silver/Mart Layer: Category Performance Aggregation
SELECT
    category,
    SUM(gross_amount) AS total_gmv,
    COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count,
    SUM(is_returned) AS returned_orders,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(gross_amount), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)), 2) AS avg_order_value,
    ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(SUM(is_returned), COUNT(DISTINCT order_id)) * 100, 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM `showcase-retail-lakehouse.main_silver.fact_orders`
GROUP BY category
ORDER BY total_gmv DESC;
